things.name: Chimpanzee

must_show: Its arms are longer than its legs.
Its head is rounded or flattened with a jaw that juts forward and a strong brow ridge.
Its body is short and wide, and its hips are long with a wide top.
It can walk on the ground on two legs or on all four limbs.
It is covered in coarse black hair.
features: It is covered in coarse black hair.
Its face, fingers, toes, palms and soles are bare of hair.
Its arms are longer than its legs.
Its hands are long with long fingers and short thumbs.
Its big toe can be turned to grasp like a thumb.
Its head is rounded or flattened with a jaw that juts forward and a strong brow ridge.
It has eyes facing forward, a small nose, round ears without lobes and a long flexible upper lip.
Its body is short and wide, and its hips are long with a wide top.
It stands about 150 cm tall on average.
It can walk on the ground on two legs or on all four limbs.
It walks on all fours by resting on its knuckles.

things.draw: A chimpanzee standing on all fours on the ground, covered in coarse black hair with a bare face, fingers and toes; its arms are longer than its legs, its body short and wide, its head rounded with a jutting jaw and strong brow ridge, and long hips wide at the top
